blocking_defects.defect: s8-shot-2 uses framing 'detail' and view 'limits-detail'. That view is not in the registry's wall_views, so PlaceStage gives it mode 'exterior' and draws the full eye-level Blackland plate at zoom 1.3 with blur 3 (PlaceStage.tsx line 209). The renderer draws the top-down lot plan (lot y 220 to 1420) through LIMITS_DETAIL.cam (f [540,700], s 1.12, a [540,780]) at z 1, so the lot covers only screen y about 242 to 1586. The eye-level plate therefore shows in a band about 242 px tall at the top (behind the disclosure chip) and about 334 px at the bottom (caption band), around a straight-down parking lot. Within one shot the picture mixes overhead and horizon viewpoints, and the frame margins change at the match cut from the overhead shot's plain ground tone to sky and landscape. Fix: treat the close as overhead or wall (overhead framing, or list limits-detail in wall_views and recheck place_check's wall share), or frame the lot so the plan fills the frame without painting over an exterior plate.
